column3: Settled midpack early - made ground into contention 2f out - asked for effort to hit the top inside final furlong - driven out and stayed on gamely to the line - won under pressure

Held up towards the back - made steady progress over 2f out - shared third place under pressure over 1f out - driven and closed on the front-runner in the final furlong - could not quite reel in the winner
Sluggish start - settled at back of field - made up good ground under pressure entering final 2f - stayed on into third at finish without threatening the front two
Settled in the pack early - crept forward under pressure 2f out - couldn't quicken final furlong and finished 4th
Held up in the back half - niggled into contention from 2f out - kept on past fading horses to finish 5th
Sat close to the pace early - driven for effort with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong - finished sixth
Went straight to the front - pressed for effort 2f out and lost command inside the final furlong - dropped away in a hurry after
Held a handy position early - urged forward with over 2f left - faded steadily to finish eighth
Sat close to the front pack early - pressed for effort and lost place over 2f out - dropped away to finish well held
Set off in front early - asked for effort 2f out - kept finding more to the line - clear and untroubled throughout
Held up towards the back - steady advance approaching final furlong then driven inside the last - unable to close on winner in closing stages
Sat close to the front - urged forward with 2f left - kept on at one level through the finish
Held a midfield spot early - driven for effort inside final 2f and closed to share second with a furlong left - couldn't find more in the closing stages to finish fourth
Held up towards the back - driven approaching final 2f - stayed on same pace - finished 5th without threatening
Settled in the pack - driven approaching 2f out - unable to find any headway - finished sixth
Hampered start - held up towards the back - failed to feature - finished seventh
Sat close to the front pack - urged forward with 2f remaining - dropped away inside the final furlong - finished 8th
Settled in the pack - pressed for effort with 2f left - faded into the final furlong to finish ninth
Set the pace from the off - urged forward with two furlongs left - fended off determined rivals in the closing stages - dug deep to prevail at the line
Hampered start - held up early - driven into contention inside final furlong - moved into second late and just failed
Settled in the pack - driven approaching final furlong - kept on to finish third a quarter-length off
Sat close to the front - pushed along a furlong out - stayed on but couldn't find more in the final 110 yards - finished third by a short head
Held up at the back - driven approaching final furlong and made late gains despite being boxed in and forced left close home - unable to find enough
Sat behind the front group - driven with just over a furlong left and looked competitive when asked to go on - lost momentum inside the final 110 yards to finish sixth
Slow to begin - settled midfield - pushed along a furlong out - faded close home to finish seventh
Held up towards the back - driven with a furlong left - soon well held

Set the pace from the outset unheld - clipped the pair of markers three and two from home - briefly reeled in after the second-last - urged along and eased clear approaching the home bend - soon dominant - kept driving after the final obstacle to assert
Tracked leader throughout - pushed along after two out and lost second before the last - fought back to reclaim the place close home
Settled towards back early - moved into contention approaching final two furlongs and pushed into second before the last - couldn't find more and edged back to third close home
Held up early - pressed for effort 3 out and made ground 2 out - went wide on the home turn - stayed on from the last to finish fourth
Held up towards back of field - pushed along and stayed on same rate from before the final flight - finished 5th beaten 15¾ lengths
Settled towards the rear of the field - pushed along and one-paced from the second-last - eventually finished sixth
Sat up with the front group - pressed for effort after two out - lost ground nearing the last and finished 7th
Settled around midfield - pressed for effort after 2 out - dropped away rapidly - well held at the finish
Settled in the pack - pushed along to close on the front group after 2 out - driven hard and faded fast on the home turn before the last
Held a midfield position - driven to advance inside final furlong and hit front close home - drew clear to score
Hesitant start - settled at back of field - driven into contention with a late surge - moved up into second close home but no closer
Sat close to the front pair - hit the front turning into the last furlong plus - stayed on under pressure - overtaken close home - couldn't find more - finished third beaten 2 lengths
Handy in the pack early - urged to chase leaders over 2f out and shared third briefly - asked for more inside final furlong but couldn't find any and finished fourth
Tracked the pace early - driven approaching the furlong pole - weakened close home to finish fifth
slow to begin - settled at the back - driven and made late headway inside final furlong - unable to close near the finish - eventually held in sixth
Settled in the pack - driven approaching final furlong - stayed on without threatening for a share of honours
Slow to break - held up towards the back before seeking room on the inner approaching 2f out - driven inside final furlong and unable to quicken
Held up towards the back - driven approaching final 2f - unable to close - finished ninth beaten 8¼ lengths
Handy early - hit front turning past two furlongs out - lost advantage soon after and faded inside closing furlong
Held up in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - failed to find extra and finished well held
Settled around the pack - made progress with 2f remaining - pushed along a furlong out then faded fast - finished 12th
Travelled keenly and hit the front early - overtaken approaching 2f out - lost ground steadily from there - finished well held in 13th
Fidgety before the off - up with the front group early - driven to keep tab but faded 2f out - well held at the finish
Settled off the pace early - improved into contention by the 7th - hit the front 2 out and asked for effort approaching the last - drove on strongly from the final furlong to score
Held up towards back of field - improving into contention when checked by fallen rival 2 out - pushed along and finished strongly to close - beaten 2 1/4 lengths in 2nd
Settled towards the back early - made progress 3 out - pushed along and stayed on from the final flight to finish third

Settled towards the back early - made progress before four out and travelling smoothly by two out - into contention entering the home straight - pressed under pressure but faded before the final fence
Settled midpack - improved into contention two out - pressed for effort but lost ground final furlong to finish fifth
Settled around midfield - improved into contention by the 7th - driven out approaching the last but faded fast inside the final furlong
Tracked front pair - stumbled 3rd - hit front before 3 out - overtaken 2 out - pressed after last then faded over 1f out
Held up at the back - stumbled two out then pushed along in vain - well held at the finish
Tracked the pace early - error at the 7th and dropped back into the pack - pushed along and fell away before 3 out - finished well adrift
Sent clear in front - lost the advantage before 3 out - pushed along before losing rider at the second-last
Held up handy in the pack - urged forward with 2f remaining - hit the front approaching the last furlong - stayed on strongly to win
Slow to break - dropped towards the back but in contention - nudged forward 2f out - angled right and stayed on strongly over 110yds out - grabbed second close home
Settled midpack early - urged forward with 2f left and stayed on gamely - drifted left to challenge close home but couldn't quite get there and gave way for second late
Sat close to pace early - driven approaching final 2f - held to fourth without finding more late
Went straight to front under pressure from rival - driven and lost advantage inside final furlong - held on for fifth without gaining further ground
Sat close to front pack early - pressed for effort inside final furlong then weakened - finished sixth
Settled in the centre of the field - pushed along inside the final furlong and met a pocket momentarily - dropped away to finish 7th
Settled towards the rear early - through the pack after the 4th - moved into contention approaching 3 out - driven before the final flight then powered clear to score
Went straight to front - clean over obstacles until faltering 2 out - pushed along before last - overtaken close home - stuck on for second

Held a forward spot early - tracking the front-runner and fencing cleanly - pressed for effort and drifting right approaching the final fence - still holding claims at that point - unable to find more late finishing third
Settled off the pace early - midfield after the 4th - dropped back approaching 3 out - pushed along and finished with running before 2 out to finish 4th
Settled at the back of the field - progress made approaching 3 out then pushed along into contention around the home turn - stayed on at one speed from the final fence
Held up towards the back - pushed along three out - stayed on from the final furlong marker without threatening the front
Settled at the back of the field - pushed along and unable to quicken after 2 out - well held at the finish
Handy early up with front group - hit the 4th awkwardly - lost touch to lead second string - asked for effort after 2 out and faded fast
Set the pace from the start - pushed along a furlong out - kept finding more to the line
Hampered at the start - settled towards the back - progress inside the final 2f - moved into second and stayed on to finish second beaten 1¾ lengths
Drifted left at the break - travelled close to the pace - pressed for effort with a furlong left - dropped to third late and held no more finishing off well beaten in 3rd
Fought for control early - tracked pace into straight and pressed for effort a furlong out - held on same pace to finish fourth
Settled close to the pace - pressed for effort with 2f left - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish fifth
Jinked right at the break - stayed in the tail of the field throughout - well held in 6th
Fought for control early - settled mid-pack - lost ground inside the final furlong - eventually finished seventh
Settled off the front group - hampered slightly 4 out - moved through nicely 2 out behind the top two - driven into the front approaching the last - stayed on to assert and win comfortably
Sat close to pace - pushed into command after two out - overtaken nearing final flight - awkward there but battled on gamely to the line
Went straight to front - pushed along after 2 out - lost the advantage and gave way in a hurry approaching the last - well held at the finish
Settled off the pace and pulling hard - pushed along after 3 out - clipped the second-last - dropped away rapidly to finish fourth
Untidy over opening two obstacles - settled at back of field - errors recurring at several fences - dropped away from 5 out - well held at finish
Settled midfield - urged forward past the 2f mark despite finding traffic - angled right approaching the final furlong - finished strongly to hit the front late and score
Tracked in second early - shared the front around 3f out - asked for effort 2f out - hit the front inside final furlong - stayed on well but overtaken late
Held up towards the back - urged forward with over 2f left - stayed on with a furlong to go - improved into third close home
Towards the back of the field early - driven up to reach third approaching final furlong - kept on to finish fourth beaten under two lengths

Went very wide from the off - linked up with the field after 2f and hit the front - came under pressure 3f out and again inside the final 2f - overtaken a furlong out - lost place close home to finish 5th
Settled in fourth early - urged forward and drifted left with 2f remaining - unable to find more in the closing furlong - finished sixth beaten 3.75L
Held up early - shaken up and made headway over 2f out but boxed in on inner - shifted right 1f out - unable to find further improvement finishing 7th
Sat behind front group - driven approaching 2f out with no headway made - hampered over 1f out and soon held

Settled midfield early - moved onto the pace by the 3f marker and sat 4th at halfway - improved into contention 3f out - pushed to the front over 2f out - pulled clear inside the final furlong - stayed on strongly to score
Sat behind the front group early - 5th at halfway - pushed into 4th 2f out - stayed on to take second late but no threat to winner
Sat behind the front group early - third at halfway - driven up to challenge the pair up front two out - second but unable to get on terms a furlong out - held that effort to the line finishing third
Held up at back of the pack - closed into contention 3f out to sit sixth under pressure with 2f left - stayed on same gait to finish fourth
Held up towards the back - pushed along and headway over 2f out - into 6th spot with a furlong left then held effort to the line finishing 5th
Sat close to the front pack early - 6th at halfway - pushed along with no gain over 2f out and stayed on same effort to finish 6th
Near front early - hit the front after 1f - challenged with 4f left - lost command with 2f to go and driven along - fourth and struggling 1f out - unable to find more at the finish
Settled towards back of field - pushed along with modest headway 2f out - stayed on same gear to finish 8th
Settled midfield early - roused approaching the straight and again 3f out - stayed on same rate late - finished 9th
Handy from the off - up with the pace and second by halfway - pressed the lead 4f out - pushed along with 3f left - unable to find more inside final 2f and well held late
Held up in the pack - pushed along but unable to gain ground over 2f out - well held at the finish
Held up towards the back of the pack - pushed along with no headway made 2f out - well held at the finish
Went straight to the front - settled just behind the pace before a furlong gone - back in 8th by halfway - pushed along with no gain 3f out and unable to find more inside the final two furlongs
Sat close to the pace early - 7th at halfway - pushed along but found nothing from 3f out - well held at the finish
Held up towards the back - pushed along and unable to make headway 2½f out - well held at the finish
Held up towards back of pack - pushed along and unable to quicken 3f out - dropped away to finish well beaten in 16th
Held up towards back of the field - pushed along and unable to quicken from 3f out - well held at the finish
Settled in the pack - pushed along with no response inside the final 3f - well held at the finish
Settled in the pack - pushed along with no response 3f out - well held at the finish
Held up at back of field - pushed along with no response 3f out - dropped away and finished well beaten
Settled towards rear - eased and stopped shortly after 2½f
Handy with front group early - driven approaching 2f out and hit front with a furlong left - challenged inside final 110yds - dug in to prevail close home
Settled in the pack - hampered when shifted wide 2f out - driven into contention to challenge for the front approaching the final furlong - couldn't find more and edged out close home
Handy early - driven to improve over 1f out - into third inside final furlong - kept on but flattened out close home
Held up at back - driven into contention inside final 2f - stayed on to move fourth close home - unable to find more late
Settled midpack early - short of space around 2f out - driven to close ground inside final furlong - faded close home to finish fifth
Settled in the pack early - shut in for room on the inner from 2f out - stayed on at one gear inside the final furlong to finish sixth
Settled towards the back - boxed in on the left approaching final 2f - pushed along inside the last furlong - stayed on same speed to finish seventh
Settled just behind the pace early - went clear 3f out - drifted left knocking the other runner near the furlong marker - lost the advantage inside the last and faded close home
Wide berth early - held a forward spot then drifted left - urged on with 2f left - squeezed for room inside the last furlong - lost touch and finished ninth

Jumped and missed the break - settled in the back half of the field - roused 3f out - nudged towards the middle and making ground over 2f out but bumped in the process - dropped out approaching the final furlong - stopped rapidly before the last 110yds to finish 10th
Settled towards the back - shifted across two furlongs out - unable to go with leading group a furlong out - dropped away soon after - allowed to drop away late finishing well beaten
Broke smartly and into an early advantage - stayed in front until overtaken 2f out - faded rapidly and hit the back marker approaching the final furlong - trailed home well beaten
Handy early - hit front with just over a furlong left - stayed on strongly to the line
Settled in the pack early - improved and pushed along inside final furlong - stayed on to the line for second
Poor break and settled at back - pushed along and drifted left approaching final furlong - rallied close home to finish third
Settled at the back early - drifted left and made progress inside final furlong - stayed on strongly to the line - finished 4th beaten 1½ lengths
Held up in the pack - pressed for effort with a furlong left - unable to find more close home - finished fifth
Settled in the pack - squeezed for space then eased right approaching final furlong - stayed on with driving to the line - finished sixth beaten 4 lengths
Handy early - hit front approaching 2f out then pressed and lost advantage inside final furlong - weakened late to finish 7th
Went straight to the front - overtaken with 2f remaining - faded inside the last furlong to finish eighth
Pulled keenly - up with the front runners - broke away on the far flank after 2f before returning to the pack 2f out - under pressure from 1f out - fading in the closing stages to finish 9th
Set the pace early - lost front spot 3 out then fought back to the front 2 out - driven out under pressure approaching last - stayed on well to prevail
Tracked the front pack early - pushed along to close the gap before the last - kept on to the line but never able to get on terms
Sat behind the front group - improved to challenge for the lead two out and looked well placed rounding the bend - lost ground before the last to finish third
Held up at the back - closed ground after 3 out and pushed along home turn after 2 out - unable to quicken and finished 4th
Settled in the pack - pushed along and found a short-lived turn of pace after the second-last - dropped away before the finish to come home fifth
Tracked the pace early - moved through to hit the front 3 out then dropped back approaching 2 out - stayed on terms before being pushed along and fading before the final flight
Settled in the pack - pushed along after 3 out - dropped away from 2 out to finish 7th
Held up towards the back - pressed for effort and dropped away after 2 out - well beaten in 8th
Settled at the back of the field - pressed for effort after two out and dropped away - eased out of contention before the final obstacle
Settled last early - pushed along inside final furlong - gained ground quickly - finished best to get up near the line
mid-pack early - pushed along inside final furlong - closed strongly late - moved into second close to line - narrowly beaten
Handy early - hit front a furlong out under urging - fought on gamely final stages - caught right at line to finish third by a short head
Settled in the pack early - moved right and made progress over a furlong out - pushed along and closed in during the final furlong - couldn't quite land the blow late finishing 4th beaten a length
Sat close to the pace - pushed along inside final furlong and made a bid in the closing stages - edged out near the line
mid-pack early - pushed along a furlong out - kept on late but never landed a serious blow - finished sixth beaten two and a half lengths
Settled at back of field - pushed along inside final furlong and made late progress - kept on to finish seventh
Went straight to the front - pressed for effort and lost command inside the final furlong - gave way close home
Held up handy in the pack - pressed for effort inside final furlong and gave way - dropped through field to finish ninth beaten 4½ lengths
settled just behind the leading group - pushed along inside final furlong - unable to land a blow finishing 10th
Settled at back of field - pushed along with 1f left - made no impact - finished 11th beaten 4¾ lengths
Sat close to the front pair early - pushed along with a furlong left - soon dropped away to finish 12th
slow to begin at back - pushed along 2f out - closed to challenge entering final furlong - hit front soon after - pulled away last 110yds
Sat close to pace early - hit front 3f out - driven approaching final furlong - fought back on there but overtaken soon after - unable to go with winner in closing stages - finished second
Settled in the pack - pushed along to close on the front-runner 2f out before slipping behind into third with a furlong left - stayed on at an even effort to finish third
Handy early stage - pushed along 2f out - faded final furlong to finish fourth
Set the pace under pressure - lost front spot and driven along 3f out - dropped away 2f out - finished fifth
Slow into stride at the off - held up towards the rear throughout - never on terms - well held at the finish
Settled midfield early - made ground into third with 3f left - driven to challenge inside final furlong and a half - got up close home to score

Settled in the pack behind the prominent pacesetter - asked for effort 2f out and made ground - up with the first two inside the final furlong - challenged hard over 110yds out - went down by a short head near the line

Went straight to front - opened a big advantage inside two furlongs and held a seven length margin 3f out - edge cut back with urging 2f out - continued to give a good account under pressure over 1f out - came under pressure from rivals inside the final furlong - held on gamely - overtaken close home to finish third
Slow into stride - settled towards back of field - driven approaching 4f out - urged 2f out - finished with renewed effort inside final furlong - up into fourth close home
Settled in the pack - driven approaching final 3f - faded inside final furlong to finish 5th
Held up towards the back - urged for effort with more than 3f to go - unable to find any improvement finishing sixth beaten 6 lengths
Poor start and settled at the back - well behind by 4f out - never a threat late on and finished 7th
Tracked the front-runner - urged forward 3f out - dropped away 2f out - finished 8th
Tracked the prominent front-runner - under pressure 3f out - dropped away before the final furlong

Contested front spot early - settled just behind pace after a furlong - second at the halfway stage - moving strongly to challenge 3f out - hit the front with 2½f left - pushed clear 1½f out and stayed on strongly to the line

Settled towards the back early - began to make headway 3f out - pressed the leader 2f out - into third with a furlong left and edged ahead late - could not overhaul the winner but battled on for second
Sat close to the front group - 4th at halfway - pushed into 2nd spot with a furlong and a half left - unable to close on the winner and finished steady in 3rd
Settled midfield - pushed along with 2f left and edged into 4th approaching the final furlong - continued at a similar effort to the line
Settled midfield - pushed along and moved forward wide 2½f out - unable to close on the front pair and stayed on same tempo to finish 5th
Settled towards the back - pushed along with 3f remaining - finished off strongly inside the closing furlong - eventually 6th
Sat close to the front pair early - still 7th at halfway - pushed along but unable to close 2f out and stayed on same gear to the line
Settled close up early - hit front after a furlong - matched stride 3f out then edged out approaching 2f out - unable to find more late
Held up towards the back - pushed along with 3f left - stayed on same gear from inside the final furlong - finished 9th
Settled at rear - pushed along and eased right under 1 1/2f out - stayed on same effort late - finished 10th
Settled midfield - pushed along and unable to close 2f out - well held at the finish
Tracked front group early - still 6th at halfway - pushed along entering final stretch and stayed on without extra gears
Held up at the back - pushed along and edged closer 2f out - checked by traffic 1 1/2f out then unable to sustain the effort - well held in 13th
Sat handy behind front group - 5th at halfway - pushed along with 2f left then held no more inside final furlong

Settled around the middle of the pack - pressed for effort with 2f left then squeezed for space and knocked off stride at the furlong and a half marker - unable to threaten thereafter and well held at the finish
Sat close to the pace pulling hard - up in 3rd at halfway - pressed for effort and unable to quicken 2 1/2f out - eventually well held
Held up towards back of field - pushed along and made no headway 3f out - well held at finish
Held up in the pack early - urged into effort before dropping towards the back by halfway - unable to find more with 3f left - well held at the finish
Settled in the pack - pushed along with nothing left 3f out - well held at the finish
Slow to begin and driven up at the back early - no response under pressure with 3f remaining - well held at the finish
Held handy in the pack - pushed along with no response inside final 3f - well held at the finish
Settled close to the pace - moved through with plenty in hand to hit the front inside the final furlong - pulled away for an easy win
Handy early - eased back into the pack after 2f - driven to close from inside final furlong - stayed on strongly to snatch runner-up spot late
Held up midpack - improved from the near flank inside final furlong - stayed on to grab third close home - flattened out late

Settled in third early - closed on the pace before 2f out - hit the front approaching the final furlong - quickly overtaken - stayed on the winner's heels inside the closing 110yds - faded to finish fourth
Settled just behind the pace early - hit the front two furlongs out - pressed for effort when overtaken inside the final furlong - dropped away rapidly near the finish to come home fifth
Held up towards the back - boxed in with 2f left - squeezed for space inside the final furlong - found some late progress close home to finish sixth

Settled towards the back - boxed in entering the straight 3f out - pushed along over 1f out - lost touch briefly - found some renewed effort inside the final furlong - stayed on to finish seventh beaten 9 lengths
Dwelt at the start - settled towards the back - made ground but drifted right approaching final 2f - lost placing inside the last - faded to finish well held
Went straight to front - lost command approaching 2f out and unable to go with leader inside final furlong - faded to finish ninth
Held up towards the back - driven to make late progress under a furlong out - overtaken and dropped away close home to finish well beaten
Sat in the pack early - drifted left approaching 3f out then faded to the back inside the final furlong - well held at the finish

Set the pace early - surrendered top spot and slipped back before halfway - dropped away entering the last quarter mile - rallied and drifted left approaching the final furlong - burst clear close home to score
Drifted left at the break - settled second - hit the front 9f out - overtaken 3f out - roused to regain command 1f out but caught in the closing stages to finish second
Slow start - settled third - moved up into second 8f out - hit the front 3f out - pushed along 2f out - overtaken inside final furlong and faded to finish third
Slow to begin - settled at the rear then asked for effort 5f out - dropped away and finished well beaten
Set the pace throughout - pushed clear approaching the last - kept finding more to the line
Sat close to leader from the off - pressed for the lead nearing the final fence - stayed on at one speed to the line - finished second beaten a length and a half
Settled at back of field - began finding extra from two out - improved into third close home
Settled towards the back - untidy over 3rd and 4th - moved into contention approaching 2 out and up into third after - stayed on same rhythm from the final stretch to finish fourth
Settled in the pack - pushed along and stayed on from 2 out - finished 5th
Settled in the pack early - pushed along and slipped towards the back - fell away after 2 out - well held at the finish
Set the pace early - lost front spot but stayed close after the first furlong - pushed back to the front inside the final furlong - kept up the effort to score
Settled at the back early - boxed in for room 2f out - found progress inside the final furlong - shifted right and driven out - grabbed second close home
Handy near the front early - hit the front after a furlong and edged clear before being overhauled inside the final furlong - just failed to hold on for second close home
Handy early - pressed for effort inside final furlong - lost ground close home to finish fourth
Settled in the pack early - progress made two furlongs out then pushed along inside the final furlong - held no more in the closing stages finishing fifth
Held up in the pack - pushed along and found space to move up into third approaching the final furlong - then faded quickly to finish sixth
settled in mid-division - pressed for a run inside final furlong - unable to make notable headway - finished seventh beaten 4¾ lengths
Held up in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - unable to make an impact - finished eighth
Settled in the pack early - pushed into contention 2f out then asked for effort inside final furlong - soon lost ground finishing ninth
Settled towards the back - lost touch with the pace three furlongs out - well beaten in tenth
Settled towards the back - crept into contention over 2f out - then pressed for effort and faded - eventually well beaten in 11th
Settled around mid-pack early - lost touch inside final 2f - unable to challenge late - finished well held in 12th
Up with the pace early - fell away after 2f and towards the back - a distant 13th
Settled in the pack - close to the front group with two furlongs to run - pushed to hit the front inside the final furlong and stayed on to prevail
Settled towards back early - pushed along with 2f left - progressed approaching final furlong - closed to be second at the line without threatening the winner
Settled off the pace early - pressed for effort 2f out - closed on the winner inside the final furlong - held on well but edged out of second near the line
Fought for control early - close behind front group - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on at one gear to the line
Up with the pace early - shared front spot 3f out - pushed clear alone 2f out before losing command approaching final furlong - weakened late to finish fifth
Pulled hard early - settled in the pack - pressed for effort with 2f left - found extra approaching final furlong - stayed on at one level to finish sixth
Fought for control early - settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - edged into contention entering the straight but faded late finishing 7th
Settled towards the back - pushed along with 2f left - nudged closer inside the final furlong - eventually finished 8th
Fought for control early - hit the front - matched by a rival 3f out - shaken up and overtaken 2f out - faded soon after into 9th
Hesitant break - settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left before fading inside the final furlong
Sluggish start - never involved - finished well off the pace in 11th
Travelled keenly in early stages - moved to front 4f out - had to work through pressure 3f out - kicked clear inside final furlong to score

Dwelt at the start - settled towards the back - shifted wide and made progress down the back straight - linked up with the pack 6f out - shadowed the front-runner 3f out - driven and still in with a shout a furlong out but outpaced close home
Settled midfield early - asked for effort 3f out and kept battling - moved into third inside final furlong - unable to close on the leading pair late on
Held up eagerly at the back - urged forward with 3f left - stayed on late to take fourth without threatening
Sat close to the front group - urged forward over 2f out - weakened steadily - finished 5th
Towards the rear of the field - dropped away and ridden over 2f out - quickly off the back of the pack
Set the pace early - urged forward with 5f left - lost the advantage 4f out - faded rapidly and was soon eased down

Settled in the pack early - moved up on the inside approaching 2f out - into 5th with a furlong and a half left - shared the advantage a furlong out then went on - stayed on well to the line for victory
Tracked the pace early - through the pack at halfway - moved into 6th 2f out and pressed for effort - up to 4th 1f out - stayed on to finish second - unable to reel in the winner

Settled just behind the front group early - up to 2nd by halfway - closed on the front-runner with 4f left - asked for effort 2f out and shared advantage entering the final furlong - held on for third at the line
Settled around midfield - pressed for effort with two furlongs left - finished strongly - fourth at the line
Went straight to front - challenged with 4f remaining - pushed along inside final 2f - lost command a furlong out and held on for fifth
Held up towards the back - pushed along and made ground wide out approaching final 2f - stayed on late to finish sixth beaten 6 lengths
Sat close to the front group early - third at halfway - pressed for effort with 2f left - unable to find more and finished 7th one-paced
